# /debug

1. Reproduce — establish input, state, environment and expected/observed behavior. If direct
   reproduction is unavailable, gather logs or a minimal fixture and state the uncertainty.
   Ask for missing evidence while continuing useful read-only diagnosis; do not guess a fix.
2. Isolate — narrow the failing path. Delegate only a substantial independent trace. Record
   what was ruled out so the investigation does not repeat itself.
3. Hypothesize — state one falsifiable cause and the observation that would disprove it.
4. Red — write the smallest test at the defect's level. Run it and confirm it fails for the
   suspected reason. Use existing regression coverage when it already captures the failure.
5. Green — fix the cause with the smallest change, then run the relevant suite. Follow
   independent requirements as the oracle when a test itself appears wrong.
6. Review — apply relevant quality/security and conditional lenses, update affected docs,
   and report symptom, cause, fix, verification and remaining uncertainty.

Bugs skip a feature spec; high-risk fixes still require the corresponding review. Commits
follow user/project authorization, with no mandatory failing-test commit.
